draft.subject: Photographing Aurora Strings at Carnegie Hall.
draft.body: I photograph performing arts in New York and saw Aurora Strings is at Carnegie Hall on March 10. For nearly ten years I have been one of the photographers working Carnegie Hall, shooting unobtrusive, no-flash documentary coverage from the house. My portfolio is at danwrightphotography.com. I would be glad to talk about your photography plans for the night, if you don't have someone on it already. I look forward to hearing from you.
